name: Pulau Mentigi
area: Mentigi Island, near Pulau Tinggi, Mersing, Johor
sourceName: OpenStreetMap beach geometry + MyGeoName Johor island identity
evidenceNote: BeachSearcher identifies a roughly 50 m beach on Mentigi Island near Tanjung Balang/Pulau Tinggi. Public OSM map API returns a single natural=beach polygon on this small islet (way 177449728); this point is the beach polygon bounding-box midpoint, not the island centre. MyGeoName Johor explicitly identifies Pulau Mentigi, Mersing. The OSM beach itself is unnamed; island, shoreline size and surrounding location establish the association.

name: Telok Pandan Kecil
area: Bako National Park, Kuching, Sarawak
sourceName: OpenStreetMap / Beach World Map public GeoCoordinates
evidenceNote: BeachSearcher confirms Telok Pandan Kecil in Bako/Sarawak. OSM way 142170514 explicitly has natural=beach and name=Teluk Pandan Kecil. BeachWorldMap Malaysia JSON-LD supplies 1.73042,110.4513 within that named beach polygon. Distinct Teluk Pandan Besar way 142235316 was excluded. Google Maps resolves the query to a clifftop viewpoint, which was excluded.

name: Mamangku Mas Mas
area: Pantai Mas Mas, southeast Sabah, near Tawau/Balung
evidenceNote: Public Maps embed for Mamangku Mas Mas Sabah returns Pantai mas mas, Semporna, Sabah, with the listed marker. BeachSearcher reviews independently call this Kg Pantai Mas Mas and locate it via Jalan Sungai Burung/Balung; Google has 33 reviews and 4.3 rating versus provider 32 reviews and 8.6 score. Marker distance to Tawau Airport agrees with the provider 18.6 km. This is a beach visitor point, not the official inland Kg Mas Mas Kalumpang village coordinate. The provider South China Sea label is geographically questionable; only the general sea water type is retained.

name: Jason Bay Beach
area: Jason Bay / Teluk Mahkota, Kampung Sungai Gading, Kota Tinggi, Johor
evidenceNote: Maps embed returns Jason Bay Public Beach (Pantai Teluk Mahkota), Kampung Sungai Gading, 81900 Kota Tinggi, Johor. This matches BeachSearcher Jason Bay Beach mainland Johor identity and nearby Sri/Sungai Gading settlement. A first-person travel GPS report independently places Jason Bay beach at 1.89876,104.10363. Jason Bay Beach II is a separate provider entry 2.2 km away and was not substituted.

name: Sunset Beach
area: Sunset Beach, Redang Island, Terengganu
evidenceNote: BeachSearcher identifies Sunset Beach on Redang Island, Terengganu. Marine Department Port Circular 10/2025 (21 July 2025) explicitly names Sunset Beach, Redang Island as the charity swim end point, with 05 degrees 47 minutes 55.2 seconds N / 102 degrees 59 minutes 41 seconds E. Converted directly from those DMS values. Langkawi, Perhentian and Sekinchan sunset beaches were excluded.

name: Adam and Eve Beach
area: Northern Perhentian Kecil Island, Besut, Terengganu
sourceName: Google Maps public place marker + OpenStreetMap relation 6390456
evidenceNote: Maps embed explicitly returns Adam and Eve Beach, Pulau Perhentian Kecil, Besut, Terengganu. Marker is inside named OSM natural=beach relation 6390456, which also carries name:ms=Pasir Panglima Abu and Wikidata Q33329365. Adjacent D Lagoon is about 460 m east as described by BeachSearcher. Rounded GeoNames and MyGeoName Pasir Panglima Abu reference coordinates are west of the small actual beach polygon and were not copied.

name: D'Lagoon Beach
area: Northern Perhentian Kecil Island, Besut, Terengganu
sourceName: Google Maps public place marker + OpenStreetMap relation 6390459
evidenceNote: Maps embed explicitly returns D Lagoon Beach, Pulau Perhentian Kecil. Marker is inside OSM relation 6390459 tagged natural=beach and name=D'Lagoon. Distances and north-Kecil island identity agree with BeachSearcher. OSM reef node 497187649 offshore and the same-named Johor neighbourhood were excluded.

name: Bida Beach
area: Pantai Bida, Kampung Pata, Kudat, Sabah
evidenceNote: Maps embed returns Pantai Bida, Kg Pata, 89050 Kudat, Sabah. This is a coastal beach marker in the Sabah/Kudat area, matching BeachSearcher Bida Beach near Kg Tinangol and Kumbatang; the provider identifies neighbouring Indarason and Bingolon beaches. Foreign Bida beaches and Sabah town/village centroids were excluded.

name: Selat Pancur Beach
area: Selat Pancur, southeast Langkawi Island, Kedah
evidenceNote: Maps embed for Selat Pancur Beach Langkawi returns the Selat Pancur visitor place, Unnamed Road, 07000 Langkawi, Kedah. It lies on the southeastern Langkawi cove about 3.3 km from Kuah, matching the provider isolated 270 m bay beach with a small waterfall. A separate WorldPlaces Pulau selat pancur point at 6.30951,99.85548 in built-up Kuah was rejected.

name: Teluk Ailing Beach
area: Teluk Ailing, Penang National Park, Penang Island
sourceName: Google Maps public place marker + OpenStreetMap beach way 275618516
evidenceNote: Maps embed explicitly returns Teluk Ailing Beach, Jalan Hassan Abas, Penang. Public OSM map API shows natural=beach way 275618516 around this point, a roughly 300 m shoreline matching BeachSearcher Penang National Park identity. Marker is on the mapped beach strip, rather than the nearby Universiti Sains Malaysia research buildings.

name: Twin Beach Resort
area: Twinbeach Sanctuary / former Twin Beach Resort, Sibu Island, Mersing, Johor
sourceName: Google Maps public place marker / OpenStreetMap resort identity
evidenceNote: Maps embed for Twin Beach Resort Pulau Sibu resolves to Twinbeach Sanctuary, Pulau Sibu, 86800 Mersing, Johor. OSM node 1880201301 retains the former Twin Beach Resort name at the same property, near beach way 177598452. Tourism Malaysia 2023 accommodation statistics list Twin Beach Resort at Lot 50 Pulau Sibu. The marker is an onshore resort reference adjacent to the beach, not an exact sand centroid. A 2022 newsletter records the resort rebranding; additional citation will be checked.

name: Dayang Island Resort
area: Dayang Island, Mersing, Johor
evidenceNote: BeachSearcher names a 300 m beach at Dayang Island Resort but assigns Pahang. Official MyGeoName places Pulau Dayang in Mersing, Johor. Public Maps embed did not return a single matching named resort/beach entity. Island gazetteer coordinates 2.47650280,104.50232220 and offshore dive coordinates were rejected because they are not beach points.

name: Labuan Gadung Bay Beach
area: Labuan Gadung Bay, near Telok Melano, Kuching, Sarawak
evidenceNote: BeachSearcher confirms the secluded Labuan Gadung Bay beach near Telok Melano, Sarawak. Public Maps embed did not yield a matching beach entity. Search results only supplied Teluk Labuan Gadung bay/fishing-water coordinates, which cannot establish the specific sandy beach. No bay centre was substituted.

name: Beras Basah Beach
area: Beras Basah Island, Langkawi, Kedah
evidenceNote: BeachSearcher confirms a 700 m beach on Beras Basah Island near Langkawi, Kedah. Public Maps embed did not yet return a matching beach entity. MyGeoName Pulau Beras Basah coordinate is an island reference, not the beach; it was excluded. The similarly named Indonesian Beras Basah island/beach was excluded. The final public Google Maps embed name query returned no explicit beach-place entity. A published geological account gives Beras Basah Island coordinates, while the sailing pilot gives an offshore anchorage; neither is a verified beach point.

name: Pemanggil Holiday
area: Pemanggil Island, Mersing, Johor
sourceName: Google Maps public place marker + Visit Mersing official listing
evidenceNote: Maps embed explicitly returns Pemanggil Holiday, Pulau Pemanggil, Mersing, Johor at the coastal resort. Official Visit Mersing listing confirms the same resort/island and Johor district (https://mersing.gov.my/listing/pemanggil-holiday/). The source marker is the beachfront property reference for the provider 1.1 km shoreline, not the island centre. BeachSearcher incorrectly labels this Pahang; official Mersing/Johor identity takes precedence.

name: Sebukang Bay Resort
area: Teluk Sebukang, Aur Island, Mersing, Johor
sourceName: Google Maps public place marker + Sebukang Bay Resort official identity
evidenceNote: Maps embed explicitly returns Sebukang Bay Resort, Pulau Aur, Mersing, Johor. Official resort site confirms it is the only resort at Teluk Sebukang (https://sebukangbayresort.biz/sebukang-bay-resort/); MyGeoName Johor lists nearby Kg Teluk Sebukang at 2.45460733,104.50358605. The Maps marker is a beachfront resort reference. The resort contact page publishes inconsistent DMS coordinates (2 degrees 45 minutes 37.83 seconds N /104 degrees 50 minutes 33.95 seconds E), far from Aur; those were rejected.

name: Sepat Camping Beach
area: Sepat camping shoreline, south of Kuantan, Pahang
evidenceNote: BeachSearcher distinguishes Sepat Camping Beach from Sepat Recreation Center Beach (3.2 km away) and Sepat Beach (13.8 km away). Public Maps embed did not return an exact camping-beach entity. A generic Pantai Sepat point would risk conflating those three provider entries, so coordinates remain null.

name: Pulau Hujung beach
area: Babi Hujong / Hujung Island, Mersing, Johor
evidenceNote: BeachSearcher confirms the approximately 610 m shore on Babi Hujong/Hujung Island, Mersing, Johor. Public Maps embed did not return an exact beach entity and OSM island-area query did not return a named beach. MyGeoName island coordinate 2.493342,103.9521 was excluded because it locates the island rather than its beach.

name: Pulau Tulai Beach
area: Tulai Island, northwest of Tioman, Pahang
evidenceNote: BeachSearcher confirms the approximately 610 m Pulau Tulai Beach near Salang/Tioman, and separately lists Pulau Tulai Beach II (1.1 km away) and Genting Bay. Maps embed did not return an exact matching beach entity. A general Tulai/Coral Island centre cannot distinguish the separate shores, so no coordinate was guessed.

name: Pulau Lakei Beach
area: Lakei Island, Bako National Park vicinity, Kuching, Sarawak
sourceName: OpenStreetMap beach geometry + MyGeoName Sarawak island identity
evidenceNote: BeachSearcher confirms the small approximately 70 m beach on Lakei Island near Bako, Sarawak (provider misspells island Lakel). Public OSM map API returns an approximately 60 m natural=beach polygon on the southwest island shore, way 675195856. This is its beach bounding-box midpoint, not the whole Lakei island centre. MyGeoName Sarawak identifies Pulau Lakei, Kuching at 1.75014418,110.49582865; that island coordinate was excluded. The beach way is unnamed, so association uses the confirmed island, small cove and shoreline dimensions.
